title: 第23章 实心眼第24章 五行真火成
slug: 精灵族的修仙者第342章巢穴
content_zh:
清早，晨光透过叶窗的缝隙倾泻而入，在树屋内投射出一道悬浮着细尘的光柱。
微小的颗粒在光束中缓缓浮沉，如同被囚禁的星屑，静谧而梦幻。
盘坐在床上的安东睁开眼睛，长长舒了口气。
一整夜的修炼下来，他对《五行化焰诀》的掌控又精进了几分
“估计再有几个月，应该就能凝聚出五行真火了。”
安东低头看向膝头，那里静静躺着一截不足掌长的树枝。
它通体泛着温润的淡青色光泽，表面浮动着细密的纹路，如同叶脉般向两端延伸，又似有水银在其中缓缓流淌。
即便只是目视着，也能感受到那股蓬勃欲出的生机，仿佛下一瞬便会抽枝发芽。
正是昨天在实战课程中夺得第一奖励的永恒树枝。
安东也是拿到手以后，才发现这东西居然还有加快灵气恢复的效果，用来辅助修炼功法和术技最好不过。
可以大幅缩短灵气枯竭后的恢复时间，显著提高修炼效率。
“倒是意外之喜。”
收起永恒树枝，安东伸了个懒腰，跳下床，推开树屋大门走了出去。
清晨微凉的空气裹挟着蜜铃花的甜香扑面而来，让人精神一振。
不出意外，罗曼已经在外面等着了。
只是她的举动让人有些摸不着头脑。
那丫头正拿着战斧，在自己手臂上比划来比划去，时而皱眉沉思，时而摇头叹气，神情专注得仿佛在钻研某种绝世难题。
安东嘴角抽了抽。
咋地，这是嫌劈树不够刺激，改行研究怎么劈自己了？
“你在干什么？”安东忍不住问道。

罗曼闻声抬头，眼睛顿时一亮，像是找到了救星：“你来得正好！快和我说说，昨天那个防御类战技是怎么回事？我回去想了一整晚都没想明白其中的关键。”
敢情是因为这个。
安东哭笑不得：“都说是魔战技了，肯定是融合了魔法，你用普通战技的思维去研究，当然研究不出门道。”
当然，这只是敷衍之词。
只有安东自己清楚，禁绝金甲压根不是什么魔战技。
罗曼修炼不了，纯粹是因为两者的能量体系截然不同。
“这样啊......”罗曼有些失望。
对于像她这样战斗风格简单直接的战士来说，禁绝金甲简直是量身打造，完全可以立竿见影地强化她的实战能力。
安东自然也明白这一点，想了想说道：“等我抽空研究一下，看看能不能修改下禁绝金甲，让你也能修炼。”
武技和战技毕竟还是有些共同之处，修改一下，或许能用魔力施展也说不定。
“真的？”
罗曼大喜过望，一把抱住安东，战斧都差点脱手落地。
“你太棒了，安东。”
少女身上还带着晨露的清新气息，银白长发蹭得他脸颊发痒。
安东无奈地拍了拍她的后背，两人笑闹片刻，才并肩朝训练场走去。
一路上，安东明显感觉到了不同。
之前他虽然也是氏族里的‘名人’，但名气只局限于年轻一代中，成年精灵看待他，与看待其他未成年族人并无二致。
温和、包容，却也带着长辈对晚辈的审视与距离。
可今日走在路上，沿途遇到的精灵，无一例外都朝他投来注目礼，眼神中有好奇、有惊叹、有审慎，像是在打量即将展翅的雏鹰。
迎面走来的一队森林卫兵，甚至主动颔首致意。

这是其他未成年精灵根本享受不到的待遇。
安东自然清楚这背后的原因，心中不禁感叹。
即便是在风气淡泊的精灵族里，实力依然是衡量一个人的重要标尺。
只要展露出足够强大的力量，哪怕尚未成年，也能赢得平等与尊重。
content_en:
Early in the morning, the morning light pours in through the gaps in the leaf windows, projecting a light beam with fine dust suspended in the tree house.
Tiny particles float slowly in the light beam, like imprisoned stardust, quiet and dreamy.
Anton, who was sitting cross-legged on the bed, opened his eyes and let out a long sigh of relief.
After practicing all night, his control of the "Five Elements Flame Transformation Technique" has become a little better.
"It is estimated that in a few months, the Five Elements True Fire should be able to be condensed."
Anton looked down at his knees, where a branch less than the length of his hand lay quietly.
Its whole body glows with a warm light cyan luster, and fine lines float on the surface, extending to both ends like leaf veins, and there seems to be mercury flowing slowly in it.
Even if you just look at it, you can feel the vitality that is about to emerge, as if it will sprout in the next moment.
It was the eternal branch that won the first prize in the practical course yesterday.
It was only after Anton got it that he discovered that this thing actually had the effect of accelerating the recovery of spiritual energy. It was best used to assist in practicing exercises and techniques.
It can greatly shorten the recovery time after the spiritual energy is exhausted and significantly improve the efficiency of practice.
"It's an unexpected surprise."
Putting away the eternal branches, Anton stretched, jumped out of bed, opened the tree house door and walked out.
The cool morning air carries the sweet scent of honeybell flowers, refreshing you.
As expected, Roman was already waiting outside.
It's just her behavior that makes people a little confused.
The girl was holding a tomahawk and gesticulating on her arm, sometimes frowning in thought, sometimes shaking her head and sighing, her expression as focused as if she was delving into some incomparable problem.
The corners of Anton's mouth twitched.
Why, you think splitting a tree is not exciting enough, so you changed your career to study how to split yourself?
"What are you doing?" Anton couldn't help but ask.
Roman raised his head when he heard the sound, his eyes suddenly lit up, as if he had found a savior: "You came just in time! Tell me, what happened to the defensive combat skill yesterday? I went back and thought about it all night and still didn't understand the key to it."
Dare to love because of this.
Anton couldn't laugh or cry: "It's said to be a magic combat skill. It must be integrated with magic. If you use the thinking of ordinary combat skills to study it, of course you can't study it."
Of course, this is just a perfunctory statement.
Only Anton himself knows that forbidden golden armor is not a magic combat skill at all.
Roman can't practice simply because the energy systems of the two are completely different.
"That's it..." Roman was a little disappointed.
For a warrior like her with a simple and direct fighting style, the Forbidden Golden Armor is tailor-made and can instantly enhance her actual combat capabilities.
Anton naturally understood this, thought for a moment and said, "Let me take some time to study it and see if I can modify the Forbidden Golden Armor so that you can also practice."
After all, martial arts and combat skills still have some similarities. If you modify them, you might be able to use magic to perform them.
"Really?"
Roman was overjoyed and hugged Anton so hard that his battle ax almost fell from his hand.
"You're great, Anton."
The girl still had the fresh smell of morning dew on her body, and her long silver hair tickled his cheeks.
Anton patted her back helplessly, and the two laughed for a moment before walking side by side towards the training ground.
Along the way, Anton clearly felt the difference.
Although he was also a 'celebrity' in the clan before, his fame was only limited to the younger generation. Adult elves viewed him no differently than other minor clan members.
Gentle and tolerant, but also with the scrutiny and distance of the elders towards the younger ones.
But today, when he was walking on the road, all the elves he met along the way looked at him with curiosity, wonder, and prudence in their eyes, as if they were looking at the young eagle that was about to spread its wings.
A group of forest guards came forward and even nodded in greeting.
This is a treatment that other underage elves cannot enjoy at all.
Anton naturally understandsThe reason behind this can’t help but sigh in my heart.
Even among the indifferent elves, strength is still an important criterion for measuring a person.
As long as you show enough strength, you can win equality and respect even if you are underage.
